hints.tr: Bir kelimenin token sayısı `math.ceil(len(p) / 4)`; noktalama işaretinin uzunluğu 1 olduğu için o da 1 çıkar.
hints.en: A word's token count is `math.ceil(len(p) / 4)`; a punctuation mark has length 1, so it also gives 1.
An empty text has no pieces, the total is 0.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import math
import re


def count(text):
    pieces = re.findall(r"\w+|[^\w\s]", text)
    return sum(math.ceil(len(p) / 4) for p in pieces)


print(count("cat"), count("capital"), count("Hello, world!"))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
import math
import re


def count(text):
    pieces = re.findall(r"\w+|[^\w\s]", text)
    return sum(math.ceil(len(p) / 4) for p in pieces)


print(count("cat"), count("capital"), count("Hello, world!"))
```
